name: How long does a typical deck board replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical deck board replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a deck board replacement project depends on the size of your deck, the complexity of its design, and the extent of the replacement. A standard residential deck board replacement for a medium-sized deck (e.g., 200-400 sq ft) might take anywhere from 3 to 7 days, including removal of old boards, surface preparation, and installation of new ones. Factors such as weather conditions, material availability, and any necessary substructure repairs can also influence the timeline. We can provide a more precise estimate after assessing your specific deck during an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deck board replacement typically takes 3 to 7 days for a medium-sized deck, depending on size, complexity, and weather.
